detailTitle: IIT Bombay - A Trip down memory lane | Insti Edition
title: IIT Bombay - A Trip down memory lane | Insti Edition
description: IIT Bombay is not only an educational but it's a place where a person goes through everything this life has to throw at them, they lose heart and rise again, they cry and laugh, they fail and achieve, and amongst this intense hustle they find their true self. We pay a tribute to this beautiful place where dreamers meet their destination and to all people who make this journey worthwhile.
achievements: Tribute to IIT Bombay campus life
Captures the emotional journey of students
Showcases the transformative experience of IIT education
Professional documentation of campus culture

title: Radhesham Lodge - A Short Film by IIT Bombay
description: On the shady streets, under a gloomy old building, struts a peddler with a ragged bag slung across his shoulder. His identity? - a mystery, the contents of the bag? - ever so more. Caught in a hustle with two local cops suspicious of his dealings, will he be able to secure himself? Will his trade end forever? Or will it lead to yet another mystery? - Watch as the events unfold, right under the shadows of Radhesham Lodge.
achievements: Compelling mystery thriller narrative
Professional cinematography and direction
Engaging storyline with suspenseful elements
High-quality production values for student film

title: Tabeer (تابیر) - Inter IIT Culturals 2019
description: A Film made for Inter IIT Cultural Meet 2019 by IIT Bombay about two friends one of which dies in one of the biggest tragic events Mumbai has ever seen.
achievements: Created for Inter IIT Cultural Meet 2019
Deals with sensitive historical events in Mumbai
Emotional storytelling about friendship and loss
Represents IIT Bombay in inter-collegiate competition

title: Khilona
description: This story revolves around a kid's conflict about God and in order to resolve this, he goes on interacting with others which confuses him even more. This confusion leads him to rebel and question the already existing concept of God. But in the end, his thoughts are suppressed by his own family.
achievements: Explores deep philosophical themes through a child's perspective
Tackles complex religious and spiritual concepts
Showcases family dynamics and generational conflicts
Thoughtful narrative about faith and questioning

title: Kya Tumhe Mera Phool Mila
description: Hostel Film Music Video GC submission
achievements: Hostel Film Music Video competition entry
Creative visual storytelling through music
Captures hostel life and emotions
General Championship (GC) submission

title: Chotu
description: 3rd Position, Best Cinematography and Direction. The story revolves around 'Chotu' a poor man, but his story is not about how the poor struggle to make ends meet or how they put aside their inner desires to put food on their plate. This story is about the humanity that lies within every human-being, the potential that people have to put others in need before themselves.
achievements: 3rd Position in film competition
Won Best Cinematography award
Won Best Direction award
Powerful social message about humanity and compassion

title: The Connection
description: The seemingly dissonant lives of two people find a beautiful harmony as the surreal connection becomes apparent.
achievements: Explores surreal connections between people
Creative narrative about human relationships
Experimental filmmaking approach
Artistic exploration of harmony in dissonance
